verses.4:
The sons of Noah: + 1:4 LXX; Hebrew does not include The sons of Noah: ; see Genesis 5:32|GEN 5:32 . 
 Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.5:
The sons of Japheth:
 Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.6: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, + 1:6 Many Hebrew manuscripts and Vulgate (see also LXX and Genesis 10:3|GEN 10:3 ); most Hebrew manuscripts Diphath and Togarmah.
verses.7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
verses.8:
The sons of Ham:
 Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.9:
The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, + 1:9 Sabta is a variant of Sabtah ; see Genesis 10:7|GEN 10:7 . Raamah, and Sabteca.
 The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.10: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one + 1:10 Or who established himself as a mighty warrior on the earth.
verses.11: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
verses.12: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites. + 1:12 Some translators adjust the Hebrew word order to the Casluhites, and the Caphtorites (from whom the Philistines came) ; see also Jeremiah 47:4|JER 47:4 and Amos 9:7.
verses.13: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, + 1:13 Or of the Sidonians, the foremost and of the Hittites, + 1:13 Hebrew and of Heth
verses.14: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.15: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.16: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
verses.17:
The sons of Shem:
 Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
 The sons of Aram: + 1:17 One Hebrew manuscript and some LXX manuscripts (see also Genesis 10:23|GEN 10:23 ); most Hebrew manuscripts do not include The sons of Aram . Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech. + 1:17 Meshech is a variant of Mash ; see Genesis 10:23|GEN 10:23 .
verses.18: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
verses.19: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, + 1:19 Peleg means division . because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
verses.20: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.22: Obal, + 1:22 LXX and Syriac (see also Genesis 10:28|GEN 10:28 ); Hebrew Ebal Abimael, Sheba,
verses.23: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
verses.24: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah, + 1:24 Literally Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah ; some LXX manuscripts Shem, Arphaxad, Cainan, Shelah ; see also Genesis 10:24|GEN 10:24 LXX and Luke 3:35–36.
verses.27:
and Abram (that is, Abraham).
 The Descendants of Abraham
 ( Genesis 25:12–18|GEN 25:12-18 )
verses.28: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.29:
These are their genealogies:
 Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
verses.32:
The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine:
 Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
 The sons of Jokshan:
 Sheba and Dedan.
verses.33:
The sons of Midian:
 Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
 All of these were Keturah’s sons.
verses.34:
Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac:
 Esau and Israel.
 The Descendants of Esau
 ( Genesis 36:1–19|GEN 36:1-19 )
verses.35:
The sons of Esau:
 Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, + 1:36 Many Hebrew manuscripts, some LXX manuscripts, and Syriac (see also Genesis 36:11|GEN 36:11 ); most Hebrew manuscripts Zephi Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
verses.37:
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
 The Descendants of Seir
 ( Genesis 36:20–30|GEN 36:20-30 )
verses.38:
The sons of Seir:
 Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.39: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. + 1:39 Homam is a variant of Hemam ; see Genesis 36:22|GEN 36:22 . Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.40:
The sons of Shobal: Alvan, + 1:40 LXX (see also Genesis 36:23|GEN 36:23 ); Hebrew Alian Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, + 1:40 LXX (see also Genesis 36:23|GEN 36:23 ); Hebrew Shephi and Onam.
 The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.41:
The son + 1:41 Hebrew sons of Anah: Dishon.
 The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, + 1:41 LXX (see also Genesis 36:26|GEN 36:26 ); Hebrew Hamran Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.42:
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. + 1:42 LXX (see also Genesis 36:27|GEN 36:27 ); Hebrew Jaakan 
 The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
 The Kings of Edom
 ( Genesis 36:31–43|GEN 36:31-43 )
verses.43:
These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: + 1:43 Or before an Israelite king ruled over them 
 Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
verses.44: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.45: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.46: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
verses.47: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.48: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates + 1:48 Hebrew the River reigned in his place.
verses.49: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.50: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, + 1:50 Many MT manuscripts, some LXX manuscripts, Vulgate, and Syriac (see also Genesis 36:39|GEN 36:39 ); most MT manuscripts Pai and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
verses.51:
Then Hadad died.
 Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
verses.54: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
